title: Uros Islands and Taquile
description: Explore the highest navigable lake in the world. Visit the floating islands of the Uros, built from totora reeds, and Taquile island, famous for its textiles declared intangible cultural heritage of humanity.

itinerary.title: Puno → Uros Islands
itinerary.description: Pickup at the port at 7:00 am. Boat trip to the floating islands of the Uros. Guided visit explaining the culture and lifestyle of its inhabitants. Typical lunch. Free afternoon to explore Puno.

itinerary.title: Taquile Island → Puno
itinerary.description: Early boat trip to Taquile island. Hike along the island's trails, visit the textile workshops and enjoy lunch with a lake view. Return to Puno at sunset.
